meta.name: Series K Legacy
meta.description:
Legacy honors Korea’s heritage with timeless tales of love, duty, and rebellion. Immerse yourself in elegant period dramas of palace intrigue and emotion, capturing the beauty and grandeur of Korean history cherished for generations.

Shows: Hwangjini Ep.18, Love in the Moonlight Ep.6, Love in the Moonlight Ep.7, Love in the Moonlight Ep.8, Love in the Moonlight Ep.9
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
